name: How does AKN Design Group integrate an ADU's design with my existing home?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group integrate an ADU's design with my existing home?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group prioritizes a cohesive aesthetic, ensuring your new ADU visually integrates with your primary residence and property. Our integrated design-build process involves careful consideration of architectural styles, exterior materials, and landscaping. We utilize CAD-supported layouts to achieve a harmonious look that enhances your home's overall curb appeal and functionality, rather than appearing as a separate, disconnected structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: We integrate ADU design with your home's aesthetic using CAD layouts, matching architectural styles and materials for a cohesive look.
